verdict.rationale: Calendly's core scheduling engine explicitly connects and syncs multiple calendars (work/personal) to check for conflicts before allowing bookings, per docs-15/42/49, and this is independently corroborated as a 'killer feature' in community discussion (comm-6). One user reports a specific failure mode when a Google Calendar is manually disabled (comm-10), which is a minor caveat rather than a systemic contradiction. Missing for 10: no first-party detail on sync latency/two-way write-back mechanics or handling of edge-case calendar disconnections beyond the one anecdotal failure.
